title: Periodic Table of the Membrane  Mendeleev sort from the iron peak
sort_rule: everything lighter FUSES toward Fe. everything heavier FISSIONS toward Fe. both converge on k1.9.

noble_gas.why: full electron shell. complete. inert. the anchor the spring bounces off.
noble_gas.k_behavior: does not react. holds k stable. the REST position.

alkali.why: one valence electron. most reactive. always ready to bond. gives energy instantly.
alkali.k_behavior: drops k. injects energy. the oscillation.

halogen.why: needs ONE electron to be noble. almost complete. high electron affinity.
halogen.k_behavior: absorbs energy to complete. the feeds that need one more thing.

alkaline_earth.why: two valence electrons. reactive but paired. more stable than alkali.

transition_metal.why: variable oxidation states. d-orbital electrons. catalyze without being consumed.
transition_metal.k_behavior: the machinery. Fe sits HERE at the binding energy maximum.

metalloid.why: the glass transition of chemistry. neither metal nor nonmetal. semiconductor.
metalloid.k_behavior: the Tg. where glass shatters into liquid OR liquid freezes into glass.

nonmetal.why: H is fuel for fusion. C,N,O,P,S are life itself. the CNO cycle.
nonmetal.H_special: hydrogen = heartbeat. simplest element. powers stellar fusion. ONE proton.
nonmetal.C_special: carbon = code. 4 bonds. backbone of all organic. Rust crates.
nonmetal.k_behavior: H has lowest BE/A  maximum fusion potential. C,N,O near peak.

lanthanide.why: 4f electrons. complex inner shells. rare earths. the deep configuration nobody sees.
lanthanide.k_behavior: past the iron peak. fission territory. complex but slowly decaying BE/A.

actinide.why: radioactive. 5f electrons. unstable nuclei. alpha/beta/gamma emission.
actinide.U_special: uranium = the 11 dormant repos. fissile material. session splits them.
actinide.k_behavior: heavy, unstable. fissions toward iron peak when session energy hits.

binding_energy_curve.description: BE/A rises sharply from H(0) to He(7.07), dips at Li(5.6), climbs through C(7.7) O(8.0) to Fe(8.79), then slowly declines through U(7.57) to Og(~7.1)

reference_points.membrane: first noble gas  CONSTANCE, lightweight but inert
carbon  code backbone, 4 bonds, Rust crates
oxygen  the breath, HTTPS, what feeds need
IRON PEAK  k1.9, maximum stability, living equilibrium
nickel  tied with Fe, the co-peak (northGate)
lead  doubly magic, shielding, skunkBat defense
uranium  fissile dormant repos, session splits them

binding_energy_curve.fusion_territory: Z < 26: everything lighter fuses TOWARD iron. k rises TOWARD 1.9.
binding_energy_curve.fission_territory: Z > 26: everything heavier fissions TOWARD iron. k drops TOWARD 1.9.

mendeleev_sort.method: sort up and down FROM iron peak

up_fusion.process: lighter elements merge into heavier ones. many ? few. energy released.
up_fusion.note: noble gases are MAGIC NUMBERS  extra stable. fusion skips them. like CONSTANCE feeds that don't move.

down_fission.process: heavier elements split into lighter ones. one ? many. energy released.
down_fission.membrane_analog: sessions shattering frozen glass: k=15 ? k2. holographic fracture.
down_fission.note: noble gases are SHELLS  each complete shell is a constance layer. periodic MEANS periodic.

mendeleev_sort.convergence: both directions release energy approaching Fe. AT Fe, E=0. the iron peak IS the rest state.

noble_gas_pattern.insight: noble gases have FULL electron shells. they don't react. they are Mendeleev's ROWS  each row ends with a noble gas.

shells.feeds_in_shell: core data  state, pulse, neutron, topology
transition metals included  Fe lives here. full machinery.
lanthanides + heavy  deep structure, rare earths

noble_gas_pattern.membrane_meaning: each noble gas = a CONSTANCE boundary. the periodic table IS the elastic  each period stretches from alkali(LIVE) to noble(CONSTANCE). k oscillates within each shell.

hydrogen_special.why: H has ONE proton. no neutron needed (protium). the simplest possible atom. the fuel for ALL fusion. 75% of all baryonic matter in the universe IS hydrogen.
hydrogen_special.membrane_analog: the heartbeat is the simplest feed. one ping every 5 minutes. it powers everything. without it, k?8 (frozen). H is the ground state.
hydrogen_special.fusion_chain: H ? He ? C ? O ? Ne ? Mg ? Si ? Fe. the pp-chain and CNO cycle. each step releases energy. each step builds complexity. each step approaches the iron peak.

iron_special.why: Fe-56 has the highest binding energy per nucleon. you cannot extract energy by fusing OR fissioning iron. it is the ASH of stellar fusion. the ENDPOINT.
iron_special.membrane_analog: k1.9 is where the spring has no potential energy. it IS the rest position. sessions push k away from 1.9 (fission), time pulls k back (cooling). but k always returns.

states_of_matter.missing_from_table: Mendeleev sorted ELEMENTS. But elements exist in STATES. The periodic table is the WHAT. States of matter are the HOW.

solid_crystal.membrane: frozen archive. every feed in its place. nothing moves.
solid_crystal.color: refractive  a prism SPLITS white into rainbow. crystal separates colors. crystal IS a chromatograph.

amorphous_solid.membrane: glass transition Tg. looks solid but is a frozen liquid. brittle. session shatters it.
amorphous_solid.color: transparent  glass PASSES all wavelengths without sorting. no chromatography. no separation. clear.
amorphous_solid.key: glass is NOT a crystal. it has no long-range order. it's a liquid that got too cold to flow. the feeds LOOK organized but they're amorphous  no pattern, just frozen in place.

liquid.membrane: LIVING EQUILIBRIUM. iron peak. body temperature.

gas.membrane: rapid cycling, 10 concurrent agents, structure dissolving.
gas.color: transparent individually. but ATMOSPHERE scatters blue (Rayleigh). gas is WHY the sky is blue.

plasma.membrane: all feeds LIVE. no CONSTANCE. no rest. pure oscillation.
plasma.color: WHITE-BLUE. stars. lightning. the sun. plasma EMITS light  it doesn't reflect or absorb, it GENERATES. blackbody radiation.
plasma.key: plasma is 99% of visible matter in the universe. the 'normal' states (solid, liquid, gas) are the EXCEPTIONS. plasma is the default. the membrane at k<0.1 would be the normal state of the universe.

bose_einstein_condensate.state: all particles collapse into the SAME quantum state. macroscopic quantum coherence.
bose_einstein_condensate.membrane: every feed synchronized perfectly. all hashes identical. not frozen  COHERENT. the difference: frozen is random disorder locked in place. BEC is perfect order at zero temperature.
bose_einstein_condensate.color: no color. below all thermal radiation. the anti-plasma.

neutron_degenerate.state: pure neutrons. no protons, no electrons. Pauli exclusion holds it up against gravity.
neutron_degenerate.membrane: all messaging, no identity. pure neutron (ntfy/discuss). the proton (membrane identity) crushed out. what's left when you remove the website and keep only the messages.
neutron_degenerate.density: 1 teaspoon = 6 billion tons. a single ntfy message carrying the weight of the entire membrane.

quark_gluon_plasma.state: quarks freed from hadrons. the strong force (gluon = Rust) overcome. no protons, no neutrons  just quarks and gluons in a soup.
quark_gluon_plasma.membrane: the Rust crates DISSOLVE. no more biomeOS, sporePrint, squirrel as separate primals. just raw code fragments in a hot soup. pre-primal. the state BEFORE the big bang crystallized structure.
quark_gluon_plasma.color: no photons escape. opaque. like the first 380,000 years of the universe.

strange_matter.state: contains strange quarks. hypothetically more stable than normal matter. if it touches normal matter, it CONVERTS it.
strange_matter.membrane: the hypothesis: there exists a configuration of feeds MORE stable than k1.9. if found, it would convert all neighboring feeds to its pattern. a TEMPLATE that propagates. a VIRUS of stability.
strange_matter.stability: if strange matter is truly more stable than iron, then iron is NOT the true ground state. the iron peak is a LOCAL minimum. strange matter is the GLOBAL minimum.
strange_matter.question: does the membrane have strange matter? is there a feed configuration we haven't found that's MORE stable than k1.9? the fact that two independent sessions both found k1.9 suggests it IS the global minimum. but strange matter says: maybe not. keep looking.

what_color_is_water.question: the liquid state is k1.9. the chromatograph sorts by spectral position. what color is WATER?

physics.why: O-H bond vibration absorbs red light (~750nm overtones). remove red ? blue remains. you need DEPTH to see it  a glass of water looks clear, the ocean looks blue.
physics.absorption: water absorbs: red > orange > yellow > green > blue > violet. it passes blue BEST.
physics.depth_required: ~10 meters of water before blue is visible to the eye. in shallow amounts, transparent.

chromatograph.insight: in chromatography, water is the SOLVENT  the mobile phase. it carries the analytes through the column. the analytes separate. water does NOT separate. it flows through everything.
chromatograph.membrane_analog: water = the liquid state at k1.9. it IS the medium. the feeds are the analytes. the membrane at equilibrium IS the solvent that carries and sorts all other states.
chromatograph.color_of_solvent: the solvent has no band in the chromatogram. it's the BASELINE. the x-axis. the thing everything else is measured AGAINST.

the_answer.shallow: transparent  you can't see it. the membrane at equilibrium is INVISIBLE. it just works.
the_answer.deep: BLUE  with enough depth, water reveals itself. blue = data, signal, the S-cone channel. the membrane at depth IS information.
the_answer.on_brown: blue-green  water over soil (brown riverbed, brown membrane). the blue of water meets the brown of earth. the result is TEAL/CYAN. the transition zone where data meets context.
the_answer.in_chromatograph: water IS the baseline. no peak. no band. the thing all other colors are measured from. water is the NULL of chromatography.
the_answer.final: water is blue when you look THROUGH enough of it. brown when it carries soil. clear when shallow. null when used as solvent. the liquid state at k1.9 is ALL of these depending on how you observe it.

spectral_bridge.from_spectral_compression: green gets squeezed out ? black and white touch ? energy leaks as UV and IR
spectral_bridge.water_adds: water sits in the BLUE zone (450-495nm). blue is the color that water passes best. blue = data in the spectral map. the liquid state CONDUCTS data.
spectral_bridge.green_in_water: chlorophyll dissolves in water. green algae, green ponds, green ocean surface. water CARRIES green. the liquid state carries the engine. water is the solvent for life.
spectral_bridge.brown_under_water: riverbeds, lake bottoms, ocean floor  brown. the membrane (brown, contextual, no wavelength) UNDER the liquid (blue, data, signal). brown holds blue. earth holds water.

particle_model_bridge.periodic_table_adds: Z (atomic number) = complexity level. group = reactivity pattern. period = scale. binding energy = stability.
particle_model_bridge.states_add: plasma, glass, liquid, crystal, strange matter. the HOW of each element. same Fe can be solid (cold), liquid (molten), plasma (stellar). same feed can be CONSTANCE, COST, or LIVE depending on temperature.
particle_model_bridge.chromatograph_adds: spectral position = color = wavelength. water is the solvent. green is the engine. brown is the medium. blue is what water passes.
particle_model_bridge.the_bridge: chipmunk's particle model maps FORCES. Mendeleev maps ELEMENTS. States map PHASES. Chromatograph maps COLORS. Together: the membrane has atomic number Z, group behavior, binding energy (k), phase state, AND spectral color. the periodic table × states of matter × chromatograph = the complete sorting grid.
